OPENCTI_URL.description: The base URL of the OpenCTI instance.

OPENCTI_TOKEN.description: The API token to connect to OpenCTI.

CONNECTOR_SCOPE.description: The scope of the connector, i.e. the entity types it imports.

CONNECTOR_LOG_LEVEL.description: The minimum level of logs to display.

CONNECTOR_DURATION_PERIOD.description: Time to wait between two runs of the connector, as an ISO 8601 duration (e.g. `PT1H` for one hour).

ROSTI_API_KEY.description: Rösti API key (get one at https://rosti.dev/api).

ROSTI_API_BASE_URL.description: Base URL of the Rösti API v2.

ROSTI_IMPORT_SINCE.description: Where to start on the first run. Either an absolute date (e.g. '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z') or a duration relative to now (e.g. 'P30D'). Later runs resume from the connector state.

ROSTI_IMPORT_IOCS.description: Import IOCs as indicators and observables.

ROSTI_IMPORT_YARA.description: Import YARA rules as indicators (pattern type `yara`).

ROSTI_IMPORT_MITRE.description: Link MITRE ATT&CK techniques, groups, software, campaigns and mitigations to reports.

ROSTI_IMPORT_CVE.description: Import CVEs referenced by reports as vulnerabilities.

ROSTI_IOC_TYPES.description: Comma-separated list of Rösti IOC types to import. Empty means all supported types.

ROSTI_IDS_ONLY.description: Only import IOCs flagged as suitable for detection (`ids: true`).

ROSTI_MAX_RISK_LEVEL.description: Skip IOCs whose false-positive risk level is above this value (0 = nothing found ... 5 = very high). 5 imports everything.

ROSTI_DEFAULT_SCORE.description: Score given to IOCs that have no false-positive risk information.

ROSTI_TLP_LEVEL.description: TLP marking applied to every object this connector creates.
